page_title: LEI 0-3 NEW | Leicester v Newcastle 07/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
90+5' A pass by Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+2' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
90+2' Wout Faes (Leicester) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the left post.
90+1' The ball goes out of play. Leicester are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) is coming onto the pitch as Kieran Trippier cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Jeremy Monga (Leicester) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
84' Leicester quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
82' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

82' The ball is cleared after Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Leicester will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
81' Ricardo Pereira (Leicester) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
81' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Nick Pope has no trouble gathering it.
80' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Leicester.
78' The resulting corner from Luke Thomas (Leicester) is cleared.
78' The resulting corner from Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Leicester will take a corner.
78' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Leicester will have a chance to score from a corner.
74' The substitution is prepared. Jeremy Monga (Leicester) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bilal El Khannouss.

74' William Osula (Newcastle Utd) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms over the bar.
74' Substitution. Ricardo Pereira (Leicester) in, James Justin out.
72' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Jacob Murphy is replaced by William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) for Alexander Isak.
70' The game is interrupted as Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is flagged offside.
68' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Mads Hermansen easily deals with the threat.
67' Leicester control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
65' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) replaces Bruno Guimaraes.
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Joelinton will be replaced by Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).
62' Robert Jones blows his whistle and it's Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
60' A dangerous looking corner kick from Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) is cleared to safety by the defence.
59' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Leicester.
56' Robert Jones blows his whistle after Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
55' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
53' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
52' The linesman raises his flag. Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is adjudged offside.
50' Leicester can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the resulting free kick, but no praise for this shot as it blazes high over the bar.
47' James Justin (Leicester) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) comes off for Stephy Mavididi.
46' Half-time substitution. Patson Daka (Leicester) will not participate anymore and Facundo Buonanotte is coming on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Nick Pope leaps to intercept the corner kick from Luke Thomas (Leicester).

43' Patson Daka (Leicester) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Leicester are going to take it.
41' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is flagged for offside.
40' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.

34' 0 - 3 Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) was in the right place at the right time. The ball arrived at his feet after a few rebounds, leaving him in an easy position to score. He can celebrate the goal.

34' Mads Hermansen was forced into action to thwart Joelinton (Newcastle Utd). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
32' The corner from Luke Thomas (Leicester) is intercepted by the defence.

31' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the roof of the net, but great anticipation by Nick Pope allowed him to make a comfortable save. Leicester will take a corner kick.
29' Luke Thomas (Leicester) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

28' Luke Thomas (Leicester) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Leicester force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
28' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

27' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Leicester have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
24' James Justin (Leicester) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
23' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

22' What a great touch by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
22' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
20' A long ball forward to Patson Daka (Leicester) is intercepted.
14' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
13' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) runs onto a defence-splitting pass and rifles in shot that zooms just past the right post.
11' 0 - 2 Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) finds his way to a high rebound and doesn't hesitate to blast it inside the left post.

11' That was absolutely fantastic! Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
9' Patson Daka (Leicester) is penalised for a foul. Robert Jones had a clear view and blows his whistle.
2' 0 - 1 Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
1' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

1' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the bottom right corner from a promising distance, but Nick Pope denies him. Leicester force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Leicester will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Jones.
